title: 2006 Raytheon ATFLIR patent and Gimbal rotation

tellings.quote: So and also this was uh a patent from I believe 2006.

plain: A patent filed around 2006 by the defence company Raytheon, for a camera and targeting pod on Navy jets known as ATFLIR, is said to explain why the object in Gimbal, a Navy video of an unidentified object that appears to rotate, seems to turn. The UFO skeptic Mick West brings the patent up himself, saying "this was uh a patent from I believe 2006." If he is right, the rotation would come from the camera's own movement rather than the object.
